results.title: Nvidia, SK Hynix send strong signal to Micron investors
results.description: Nvidia flags extreme memory pricing, and SK Hynix sees no supply balance until 2030. Here's what it signals for Micron stock ahead of Sept. 30 earnings.

results.title: JPMorgan sends stark warning on $100 oil
results.description: JPMorgan Chase says it cannot model the Iran conflict’s endgame, with oil above $100 and remaining inventories offering only temporary relief.
